shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -20 && printf '\\n--- root files ---\\n' && ls -la"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src ---\\n' && find src -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,160p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- index ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- agents ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i '/required"'$/d'"' src/App.tsx
sed -i 's/<App />,/<App />/' src/main.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css && git diff --stat && cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -maxdepth 2 -type f -delete
find dist -mindepth 1 -type d -empty -delete
git status --short'
